content: ⌊ DRAFT g The NvM Low Proxy shall provide, for each SwCluCNvMBaseSocket , a SwCluC_NvMProxy_Init API, to initialize the NvM High Proxy of an Applicative Software Cluster . This shall be one element of the service resource SwCluCNvMBaseSocket .
